env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^int other$'
stdout '^pair struct$'
stdout '^helper other other$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
grep '^func F_logosct' out/main.go
grep -count=2 '^func F_logosct[0-9][(]' out/main.go
! grep 'F_logosct2' out/main.go
! grep 'F\[int\]' out/main.go
! grep 'F\[Pair\]' out/main.go
! grep '"comptime"' out/main.go

cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectctmemo

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"fmt"
)

type Pair struct {
	X int
	Y int
}

func F[T any]() string {
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		return "struct"
	} else {
		return "other"
	}
}

func helper() string {
	return F[int]() + " " + F[int]()
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("int", F[int]())
	fmt.Println("pair", F[Pair]())
	fmt.Println("helper", helper())
}
